name: spm
title: Serial-parallel multiplier (SPM): own constraints and pin order
description: LibreLane's reference design, with its own SDC files for implementation and sign-off, a pin order file and settings tuned for sky130 and gf180.
teaches: Your own timing constraints (PNR_SDC_FILE and SIGNOFF_SDC_FILE) and pin order (IO_PIN_ORDER_CFG).
